A '''male Voss''' was a member of the [[Star Cabal]] during [[3640 BBY]]. He was participating in a holo-conference with other members of the Cabal when the [[Star Chamber (space station)|Star Chamber]] in the [[Null Zone/Legends|Null Zone]] was attacked by [[Cipher Nine]] and what remained of [[Imperial Intelligence (Sith Empire)|Imperial Intelligence]].
